summary: Belgrave Street is conveniently situated in the popular Eastbourne area of Darlington, offering excellent access to a wide range of everyday amenities and transport links. The property is within easy walking distance of Darlington railway station and the town centre.
description:
This two bedroom mid terrace is situated in an ideal location for commuters and those seeking convenient access to shops, restaurants and leisure facilities. With the addition of nearby supermarkets, retail outlets and convenience stores, a variety of local schools and healthcare services are also close by. The area enjoys good road connections to the A66 and A1(M), providing straightforward travel across the region. With surrounding traditional terraced homes this sought after area is popular with first-time buyers, investors and families alike. Its combination of established residential surroundings, practical local amenities and excellent connectivity makes it a convenient and well-placed location within Darlington. An excellent ready-made investment opportunity and is currently tenanted, generating an income of £600 per calendar month. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance leading to a comfortable lounge, separate dining room and fitted kitchen. To the first floor are two well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom.

ENTRANCE The property is accessed via a UPVC double-glazed entrance door, which opens directly into the lounge.

ENTRANCE LOBBY The property is entered through an entrance lobby, providing a welcoming first impression and offering access into the principal lounge, creating a practical transition into the main living accommodation.

LOUNGE The lounge is a bright and welcoming reception room featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window that allows for an abundance of natural light, complemented by laminate flooring and a radiator, creating a comfortable and practical living space.

DINING ROOM The dining room is a well-proportioned space featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window, laminate flooring and a radiator. A useful built-in understairs storage cupboard provides additional practicality, while a door leads through to the kitchen, creating a functional layout for everyday living and entertaining.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of matching base and wall units complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob and chimney-style extractor hood, while plumbing is provided for an automatic washing machine. The room is further enhanced by inset ceiling spotlights and a UPVC framed double-glazed window, with a UPVC double-glazed door providing direct access to the enclosed rear courtyard.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing provides access to both bedrooms and the family bathroom, offering a central and practical layout to the upper accommodation.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a well-proportioned double room featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window and a radiator. The room offers ample space for a range of bedroom furniture, making it a comfortable and versatile principal bedroom.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two is a well-proportioned room featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window, radiator and a wall-mounted gas central heating combination boiler, providing efficient heating and hot water to the property.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath, wash hand basin and WC. The room benefits from splashback panelling to the vanity areas, along with a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light and ventilation. A radiator completes the space, ensuring comfort throughout the year.

EXTERNALLY Externally, the property benefits from an enclosed rear courtyard, offering a pleasant and low-maintenance outdoor space ideal for seating and relaxing. The courtyard also provides gated access, adding convenience and practicality.
